goal: Implement the hybrid frontend workspace foundation, ViewModel boundaries, and independent TurnRun/model/sync UI states against frozen contracts and fakes.
non_goals: Do not modify Room, DAO, Entity, protocol parser, SecretStore, HTTP client, or Python service code.
Do not duplicate domain concurrency or conflict resolution rules in ViewModels.
Do not revert unrelated user or worker changes.
acceptance_criteria: The four-page workspace defaults to Session home and preserves interaction locks.
New screens use StateFlow UiState and explicit UiAction boundaries.
Independent TurnRuns render and retry separately.
Offline mode retains local session and dashboard content.
No frontend source imports DAO, Entity, SecretStore, or HTTP types.
verification_expectations: Run app and feature JVM tests.
Report any required shared Gradle changes without editing controller-owned settings files.
